title: PaneScroller escalation retries the Visible read until the redraw lands, instead of trusting one immediate read
action: Live investigation (2026-07-27) of PBI-059's persistent 'nudge-up flickers but never scrolls' report, after the frontend fix (terminal-scroll-nudge-buttons-3) was already deployed and still failed to reproduce a scroll. Direct API test (curl ?history=1 vs plain live) on every currently-running Claude Code pane showed byte-identical content -- proving the backend escape-injection escalation (src/herdr/pane_scroller.rs's read_history_with_strategy, D4 of terminal-scrollback-agent-panes) never actually revealed richer content in production, despite being live-verified as working when that feature was built. Reproduced the root cause directly against the real herdr socket (bypassing herdr-go): `herdr pane send-text <pane> $'\x1b[5~'` followed immediately by a read returns the stale pre-scroll screen every time (0/3 trials differed); the same send followed by a 5-50ms sleep before reading reliably shows the revealed older content (3/3, and 12/12 across multiple delay values 5-200ms). Root cause: Claude Code's TUI (Ink/React) redraw is asynchronous relative to the PTY byte delivery that `send_text` confirms -- the immediate `read_pane(Visible)` call right after `send_text(PAGE_UP)` races ahead of the redraw. Fix: poll (bounded retry, ESCALATION_READ_ATTEMPTS=5, ESCALATION_READ_INTERVAL=40ms) re-reading Visible until it's richer than the pre-scroll baseline or the attempt budget is exhausted, then proceed exactly as before (always restore-to-bottom). Added a FakeHerdr test seam (`set_reveal_delay`) to model the redraw lag so this is regression-tested without real sleeps in the suite (tokio::time::pause via `start_paused = true`, added `tokio` to [dev-dependencies] for the `test-util` feature).

truths: read_history_with_strategy re-reads Visible after PageUp instead of trusting a single immediate read
the retry loop stops early once a read is richer than the pre-scroll baseline
a pane whose redraw never lands within the attempt budget still gets the restore-to-bottom Ctrl+End and returns the last (stale) read rather than erroring or hanging
the existing harmless-no-op short-pane case still sends exactly PageUp then Ctrl+End, nothing more

artifacts.substantive: bounded retry loop between send_text(PAGE_UP) and read_pane(Visible), plus 2 new regression tests using the delayed-reveal seam
set_reveal_delay test seam modeling N stale reads before the escape_reveal shows
tokio test-util feature added to [dev-dependencies] so tests can pause the clock instead of sleeping for real

key_links: retry loop reuses the existing is_richer() helper as its stop condition, no new comparison logic
prohibitions: no change to NativeScrollback's never-touches-send_text guarantee
no change to the always-restore-to-bottom behavior
